hindi: तू अदिति के लिए सींचने वाला है। हे विष्णु, तू चोटी है। ऊन-सा कोमल, देवों के लिए सुखद आसन तुझे मैं बिछाता हूँ। भूमि के पति के लिए स्वाहा, भुवन के पति के लिए स्वाहा, भूतों के पति के लिए स्वाहा।
english: You are the moistening for Aditi. O Viṣṇu, you are the crest (stupa). Soft as wool, a good seat for the gods, I spread you. To the lord of the earth, svāhā; to the lord of the world, svāhā; to the lord of beings, svāhā.
notes: stupaḥ: a tuft or crest (of hair); 'viṣṇo stupo 'si' is read as a vocative plus 'you are the crest'. bhuva-pataye: bhuva- (earth) as first member, distinct from bhuvana- in the next formula. bhuva- is kept as a distinct word (the middle world?), not "earth"; the compound is contested: human check.

english: May the Gandharva Viśvāvasu lay you around, for the safety of all, of the sacrificer; you are an enclosing-stick; Agni is praised by Iḍā. You are Indra's right arm, for the safety of all, of the sacrificer; you are an enclosing-stick; Agni is praised by Iḍā. May Mitra and Varuṇa lay you around on the north with firm dharma, for the safety of all, of the sacrificer; you are an enclosing-stick; Agni is praised by Iḍā.
notes: ariṣṭayai: the edition prints ariṣṭayai (dative, 'for unharmedness'); kept as printed. 'agnir iḍa īḍitaḥ': iḍaḥ taken as genitive of iḍ ('praised by/of Iḍā, the libation-praise'); a vocative 'O Iḍā' is also possible. The second danda is attached to īḍitaḥ in the source (token 'ī̭ḍi̱taḥ|'). "iḍaḥ" is obscure (genitive of Iḍā or vocative); "praised by Iḍā" is uncertain.

hindi: तू समिध् है। सूर्य तुझे पूर्व से किसी भी अभिशाप से बचाए। तुम दोनों सविता की भुजाएँ हो। ऊन-सा कोमल, देवों के लिए सुखद आसन तुझे मैं बिछाता हूँ। वसु, रुद्र और आदित्य तुझ पर बैठें।
english: You are a fuel-stick. May the sun guard you from the east against any curse. You two are Savitṛ's arms. Soft as wool, a good seat for the gods, I spread you. May the Vasus, the Rudras, the Ādityas sit upon you.
notes: kasyāścid abhiśastyai: dative form in the sense 'against any curse' (so also prasityai, duriṣṭayai in unit 20). hindi: तू घृत से भरी है, नाम से जुहू; वह यहाँ प्रिय धाम के साथ प्रिय आसन पर बैठ। तू घृत से भरी है, नाम से उपभृत्; वह यहाँ प्रिय धाम के साथ प्रिय आसन पर बैठ। तू घृत से भरी है, नाम से ध्रुवा; वह यहाँ प्रिय धाम के साथ प्रिय आसन पर बैठ। प्रिय धाम के साथ प्रिय आसन पर बैठ। वे ऋत की योनि में अटल बैठी हैं; हे विष्णु, उनकी रक्षा कर; यज्ञ की रक्षा कर, यज्ञपति की रक्षा कर, मुझ यज्ञ के नेता की रक्षा कर।
english: You are ghee-laden, Juhū by name; sit here, she, with your dear abode upon the dear seat. You are ghee-laden, Upabhṛt by name; sit here, she, with your dear abode upon the dear seat. You are ghee-laden, Dhruvā by name; sit here, she, with your dear abode upon the dear seat. With your dear abode sit upon the dear seat. Firm they have sat down in the womb of order (ṛta); guard them, O Viṣṇu; guard the sacrifice, guard the lord of the sacrifice, guard me, the leader of the sacrifice.
notes: Juhū, Upabhṛt, Dhruvā are the names of the three ladles (the line itself says 'by name'). 'sedam' = sā idam: 'she, here' with the imperative āsīda (2 sg.), an awkward mixture of third-person pronoun and second-person verb kept as in the text. The fourth 'priyeṇa dhāmnā ... āsīda' has no name clause. yajñanyam: accusative of yajña-nī 'sacrifice-leader'; the accent in the source falls oddly.

hindi: हे अग्नि, वाज को जीतने वाले, वाज की ओर दौड़ने जा रहे तुझ वाजजित् को मैं पोंछता हूँ। देवों को नमस्कार, पितरों के लिए स्वधा। तुम दोनों मेरे लिए सुगमता से वश में रहो।
english: O Agni, winner of strength, you who are about to run the race, winner of strength, I wipe you clean. Homage to the gods; svadhā to the fathers. May you two be easily guided for me.

english: You are veda; whereby you, O divine Veda, became veda for the gods, thereby be veda for me. O gods, finders of the way, having found the way, go the way. O lord of mind, place this sacrifice, O god, in the wind; svāhā.
notes: veda: the bunch of grass used for sweeping, and 'knowledge'; kept as 'veda'. bhṷ̄yāḥ: the source carries an accent on ū; bhūyāḥ is 2 sg. precative. dhāḥ: 2 sg. aorist injunctive of √dhā. hindi: द्युलोक में विष्णु ने जागत छन्द से पग बढ़ाया; वहाँ से वह बहिष्कृत है जो हमसे द्वेष करता है और जिससे हम द्वेष करते हैं। अन्तरिक्ष में विष्णु ने त्रैष्टुभ छन्द से पग बढ़ाया; वहाँ से वह बहिष्कृत है जो हमसे द्वेष करता है और जिससे हम द्वेष करते हैं। पृथिवी पर विष्णु ने गायत्र छन्द से पग बढ़ाया; वहाँ से वह बहिष्कृत है जो हमसे द्वेष करता है और जिससे हम द्वेष करते हैं; इस अन्न से, इस प्रतिष्ठा से। हम स्वर् को पहुँचे; हम ज्योति से युक्त हुए।
english: In the sky Viṣṇu strode out with the jāgata metre; from there excluded is he who hates us and whom we hate. In the mid-air Viṣṇu strode out with the traiṣṭubha metre; from there excluded is he who hates us and whom we hate. On the earth Viṣṇu strode out with the gāyatra metre; from there excluded is he who hates us and whom we hate; from this food, from this foundation. We have reached the light; we have become united with light.

english: You are self-existent, the best ray; you are the giver of splendour; give me splendour. I follow the course of the sun.

hindi: हे अग्नि गृहपति, हे अग्नि, तुझ गृहपति के द्वारा मैं अच्छा गृहपति होऊँ; हे अग्नि, मुझ गृहपति के द्वारा तू अच्छा गृहपति हो। हम दोनों के गृहपत्य सौ शीत ऋतुओं तक अकेले-जुते न हों। मैं सूर्य की गति का अनुसरण करता हूँ।
english: O Agni, house-lord, by you, O Agni, the house-lord, may I be a good house-lord; by me, O Agni, the house-lord, may you be a good house-lord. May the household affairs of us two be not single-yoked for a hundred winters. I follow the course of the sun.
notes: asthūri: literally 'not with one draught-animal' (a-sthūri), used of a well-provided household; rendered 'not single-yoked (not scanty)'. nau: genitive dual, the sacrificer and his wife are not named in the line. mayā'gne: avagraha marks mayā + agne.

english: Homage to you, O fathers, for sap; homage to you, O fathers, for dryness; homage to you, O fathers, for life; homage to you, O fathers, for svadhā; homage to you, O fathers, for the terrible; homage to you, O fathers, for wrath; homage to you, O fathers; O fathers, homage to you. notes: rasāya, śoṣāya, jīvāya, svadhāyai, ghorāya, manyave: datives of purpose ('for ...'); śoṣa taken as 'drying up, dryness'. sataḥ: genitive of the present participle of √as ('of what is'), partitive. deṣma: 1 pl. aorist optative of √dā.
lines_deva: नमो॑ वः पितरो॒ रसा॑य॒ नमो॑ वः पितर॒ः शोषा॑य॒ नमो॑ वः पितरो जी॒वाय॒ नमो॑ वः पितरः स्व॒धायै॒ नमो॑ वः पितरो घो॒राय॒ नमो॑ वः पितरो म॒न्यवे॒ नमो॑ वः पितर॒ः पित॑रो॒ नमो॑ वो गृ॒हान्न॑ः पितरो दत्त स॒तो व॑ः पितरो देष्मै॒तद्व॑ः पितरो॒ वास॒ आध॑त्त
lines_iast: namo̭ vaḥ pitaro̱ rasā̭ya̱ namo̭ vaḥ pitara̱ḥ śoṣā̭ya̱ namo̭ vaḥ pitaro jī̱vāya̱ namo̭ vaḥ pitaraḥ sva̱dhāyai̱ namo̭ vaḥ pitaro gho̱rāya̱ namo̭ vaḥ pitaro ma̱nyave̱ namo̭ vaḥ pitara̱ḥ pita̭ro̱ namo̭ vo gṛ̱hānna̭ḥ pitaro datta sa̱to va̭ḥ pitaro deṣmai̱tadva̭ḥ pitaro̱ vāsa̱ ādha̭tta

hindi: हे पितरो, गर्भ को, कमल की माला पहने कुमार को, स्थापित करो, जिससे यहाँ पुरुष हो।
english: Bestow, O fathers, an embryo, a boy wearing a lotus garland, so that there may be a man here.
lines_deva: आध॑त्त पितरो॒ गर्भं॑ कुमा॒रं पुष्क॑रस्रजम् । यथे॒ह पुरु॒षोऽस॑त्
lines_iast: ādha̭tta pitaro̱ garbha̭ṃ kumā̱raṃ puṣka̭rasrajam | yathe̱ha puru̱ṣo'sa̭t

hindi: ऊर्ज, अमृत, घी, दूध, कीलाल और परिस्रुत् ढोती हुई, तुम स्वधा हो; मेरे पितरों को तृप्त करो।
english: (You) bearing nourishment, immortality, ghee, milk, kīlāla and parisrut: you are svadhā; satisfy my fathers.
notes: vahantīḥ: feminine plural participle; the addressees (the waters) are not named in the line. kīlāla, parisrut: kept as drink names.
lines_deva: ऊर्जं॒ वह॑न्तीर॒मृतं॑ घृ॒तं पय॑ः की॒लालं॑ परि॒स्रुत॑म् । स्व॒धा स्थ॑ त॒र्पय॑त मे पि॒तॄन्
lines_iast: ūrja̱ṃ vaha̭ntīra̱mṛta̭ṃ ghṛ̱taṃ paya̭ḥ kī̱lāla̭ṃ pari̱sruta̭m | sva̱dhā stha̭ ta̱rpaya̭ta me pi̱tṝn
